scenes.title: The Red Ribbon
scenes.summary: On Tuesday morning Youngmi happily recovers her own suitcase while the unclaimed bag stays locked away.

scenes.title: No Milk in the Fridge
scenes.summary: Twenty minutes before breakfast, Sora's supplier van breaks down and the kitchen is out of milk and eggs.

scenes.title: Counting the Change
scenes.summary: Mina returns breathless with two full grocery bags and counts the exact change for Sungmin.

scenes.title: Herbs from the Courtyard
scenes.summary: Junho clips fresh green herbs from his courtyard pot to finish the scrambled eggs right on time.

scenes.title: Juice on the Tie
scenes.summary: Youngmi enjoys her tea without sugar while Sungmin tries to impress the room and spills orange juice on his silk tie.

scenes.title: The Friday Caller
scenes.summary: A nervous male caller phones the front desk to check on the blue suitcase and hangs up without giving his name.

scenes.title: How Regulars Order
scenes.summary: During the quiet afternoon lull, Sora teaches Mina the cafe orders while Junho fixes a wobbly chair.

scenes.title: Two Names, One Room
scenes.summary: Checking the evening ledger, Sungmin turns pale: he booked two separate guests into Room 7 on a sold-out night.
